packageRules.description: visual-analysis crates share types across one git revision; a partial bump compiles two incompatible copies, so update them as one cohort.
Crates from one git repository must move together; single-crate digest bumps split the graph across revisions.
The Expo SDK fixes React Native and its native modules to one tested set; move them with `bunx expo install --fix` during an SDK upgrade instead of independently.
